prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "halka". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "slip".
Scene: Adult in winter coat momentarily losing footing on icy sidewalk, one foot sliding, arms balancing, no injury or dangerous traffic.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "halka = slip; lose your footing on a slippery surface.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Han halkar på isen.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
